Every wealthy person knows something most people never learn.

Kevin Trudeau says the rich understand the power of the mastermind. That means meeting and building relationships with people who are motivated, inspired and full of success habits.

He points to Napoleon Hill's Think and Grow Rich, which drew on men like Carnegie, Ford, Morgan and Rockefeller. All of them said the same thing: you must create a mastermind.

Who is in your circle right now, and what are they teaching you without saying a word?
